parts:

i'm trying to deploy my application and getting an error in the last step: (error in red, below)
The application is successfully loaded to my shinyapps.io web account, however the URL is missing!!

here is the run - the error and screen-shot from the URL missing (attached) ....

> deployApp(appDir = getwd(), account = 'danalyticshrasof')
Preparing to deploy application...

Any tip from your side? Appreciate every help.

Thank you
